main_text.p: gnam quandam substantiam degenerat ac mutatur. In suis autem vasis corrumpi ne-quit,q; ibi corruptionis causa careat.Est em præcostus, & excrementorum expers.Idcir co in utero corrumpitur, propterea quod non cocipitur,nec permiscetur virili,a quo perfici debet, sed multis excrementis illic aceruatis,quæ ipsum labefactant.Nihil prę terea mirum est,si suppresso menstruo exci tetur uteri præfocatio,quum nihil eo repe-riatur magis mostrificum,quemadmodum testatur Plinius libro naturalis historiae se-ptimo. Profluvio mulierum(inquit)super-uentu,acescunt multa,sterilescunt taq; fruges,moriuntur infita,exuruntur hortorum germina & fructus arborum,quibus insi-dere,defidunt: speculorum fulgur aspectu ipso hebetatur,acies ferri perstringit, ebo-risq; nitor,aluei apu emoriuntur: æs etiam ac ferrum rubigo protinus corripit,odorq; dirus aera inficit. Et in rabiem aguntur gu-stato eo canes,atq; infanabili veneno mor-sus inficitur.Quin & bitumen sequax alio-quin ac lenta natura in lacu Iudęæ(qui vo-catur Asphalthites)certo tempore natans, nequit sibi avelli ad omnem cōtactum ad-hærens præterquam filo,quod tale virus infecerit.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "præcostus" (ft ligature read as long s + t), "taq;" (abbreviation before "fruges" read as taque, marked by its form only), "infita" printed as is (possibly insita), "apu" with no visible mark, "cōtactum" (the word is faint). Two faint pencil marks in the left margin (a small scribble near the upper left) are handwriting and were left out. The page number is printed at the top left as "202". The running head is in capitals and was normalised to NATUR under rule 5.
